title: Custom eggless engagement cakes for Rosehill and Camellia families
summary:
An engagement party in Rosehill or Camellia usually has one problem no one plans for: half the guest list is vegetarian or Jain, and most cakes in Western Sydney still have eggs in the sponge.

Harris Park has solved that since 2019. Every cake is 100% eggless — not some cakes, every cake. 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, buttercream or fondant, any design from a photo reference.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Pickup from Wigram Street, a short drive from Rosehill and Camellia.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. We speak Hindi and Gujarati too.
